items.question: How will I receive my UAE visa?
items.answer: Once your visa processing is complete and approved by the immigration authorities, it will be sent directly to your registered email address in a secure PDF format.

items.question: Is visa fees refundable if my application is rejected?
items.answer: Legally, as per government regulations, visa application fees are paid for the processing effort. In case your application is rejected by the immigration department, the fees are non-refundable.

items.question: How many days will it take to process my visa?
items.answer: Standard processing typically takes 2 to 4 working days. For urgent requirements, our Express service can facilitate the process within 24 to 72 business hours, subject to government system availability.

items.question: What are the different types of UAE visas available?
items.answer: We offer various options including Tourist Visas (14, 30, or 60 days), Single or Multiple Entry, and Transit visas. Your choice should depend on the purpose and duration of your visit.

items.question: What are the penalties if I overstay in the UAE?
items.answer: Overstaying is a serious legal violation. Fines start at AED 50 per day. Furthermore, overstaying can result in a lifetime ban from entering the UAE and other GCC countries. We strongly advise renewing or exiting before your visa expires.
